About:

Meet Kuni | Apply Here

Kuni is a 1-year-old Jindo Mix weighing 34.3 lbs. Young, warm, and full of potential, Kuni is a sweet girl just getting started on her journey — ready to grow and thrive in a loving home. She can't wait to find her forever home in NYC!

You don’t have to wait for an adoption event. In-person meet-and-greets are available in the NYC area, with virtual meet-and-greets available for adopters outside NYC.

Meet Us at Our Next Adoption Event

Where: Spicy Moon Bowery - 265 Bowery, NY NY

When: Sat, September 19th

Time: 1-5pm
